_doc: The surf_src_sidistic walls in map order, for autoresearch/ladder.py and the 2x stop rule (PROTOCOL.md). october_step = the cumulative checkpoint step at which the October lineage's GREEDY eval from the true start first got past the wall (r2b2_sband scratch -> sbandx -> sdef -> sband2 -> r3b3 -> r4b3 -> r5b4 -> r6b2 -> r7b2). deadline_step = 2 x october_step (the user, 2026-11-08: 'if the algorithm doesn't beat the wall in twice time it was beaten before, then the algorithm doesn't work'), except the first wall (seed noise, see its note). A wall is cleared in an eval when its best episode passes progress_pct on config.field (goalc_32, start_d 99,675 u), or the eval entered checkpoint curtain sgcp_<cp> (score.py max_cp), or an episode finished. The lineage changed its recipe between walls (the notes say where), and from-scratch runs cleared walls 3-6 two to four times sooner (r3b2: CP3 at 1.9B, 54% at 2.49B), so the early deadlines are loose: compare at matched steps with the operator's control as well. Built 2026-11-08 from ~/ar/runs and ~/ar/archive (trainer greedy lines and evals re-scored with score.py). Each october_step can be late by one eval interval (75M early, 3-25M later).
